stage.name: The Lycaeum
stage.type: Bonus stage (wiki id EX_LYCAEUM; unlocked by collecting 50 Vacuums; released 6 June 2026)
stage.spawn_type: Mapped: enemy spawns change depending on the player's location. In the bookshelf interior, enemies only spawn from the east and west ends of the player's screen.
stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox lists no normal-mode starting spawns or player speed; starting_spawns 20 is the Hyper value (also matches the 0:00 minimum), player_speed 1 assumed. Hyper: greed 1.7, luck 1.1, +100% move speed per prose, projectile speed field ambiguous. Inverse: greed 3.2, luck 1.2, enemy health x3 (+0.05/min), enemy speed +0.005/min. Hyper is unlocked by default.
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Periodic spawning stops while 300 or more enemies are alive; only bosses and map-event enemies can still spawn (Map event page).
stage.spawn_rule: Each minute's wave has a minimum enemy count and a spawn interval. If alive count < minimum, spawn until the quota is filled; otherwise spawn one of each enemy type in the wave per interval. Bosses are teleported back onto screen rather than despawned.
stage.map_event_chance_rule: Event chance is divided by player Luck (chanceWithLuck = eventChance / totalLuck); evaluated per repeat; no chance or 0 means guaranteed.

passives.position: dropped by the Giant Enemy Crab bosses (red-button crabs)

relics.position: Big Troubler at the top, 60000 gold
Big Troubler, 180000 gold, after the secret is completed

stage.destructibles: Blue braziers along the walls (light sources); dchance 80% (max 90%), max 16.

layout.size_note: Finite, not sized on the wiki. A wide bottom section (bookshelf interior) with a large open area below it, and a large vertical section in the center (about 10 coffin floors left + 5 button floors + 10 coffin floors right, exact size unknown) leading up to the surface and Big Troubler at the top.
layout.obstacles: Bottom interior: bookshelves scattered about as obstacles (moderate). Vertical section: floors/doors with a coffin every other floor. Black impenetrable border out of bounds.
layout.theme: Sunken school under a sunlit lake: submerged library with bookshelves, blue braziers, deep-sea creatures; as the player ascends the background rises and reveals a ruined city on the surface; music intensifies (Murder on the Seafloor).
special_mechanics: Finite map surrounded by an impenetrable black border; screen darkens near the east, south and west edges; touching the east/west edges replaces all enemies with Sig.ra Blu.
Mapped spawns: in the bottom interior, enemies spawn only from the east and west sides of the screen.
Large open area below the stage constantly spawns Moon Anforas and occasionally Moongolow Atlanteans.
Three red buttons (center and both edges) each summon a Giant Enemy Crab boss that drops an Empty Tome.
Entering the central vertical section spawns The Drowner (guaranteed), killable by damage or by reaching the top.

Coffins on every other floor drop a Treasure Chest (collectable only with Mad Groove VIII, Edge of the Earth VIII or Lavatrix Machina/Vacuum) or a Yellow Sign stage item; 10 coffins left, 5 buttons that summon Itchiocentaurs, 10 coffins right.
Big Troubler merchant at the top; reaching the top enables teleporters to the halfway point and top; Golden Eggs are disabled until the top is first reached.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

rosary.effect: kills all enemies (on screen) that are not immune to instant kill; bosses/Reaper resistant

orologion.effect: freezes all enemies for 10 seconds; frozen enemies do not move or damage the player and can be pushed by walking into them; newly spawned enemies also freeze

vacuum.effect: pulls all Experience Gems on the ground to the player; ignores other pickups; takes time to arrive

nduja.effect: player breathes fire in facing direction for 10 s (damage 30, cooldown 0.5s, interval 0.04s per weapon table)
